reviews.comment:
Online course; Most of your learning / homework is reading the textbook. This course style has its pros & cons, but I would say it's overall fine. A textbook can't be as good nor as bad as irl professors, giving you flexibility on when you want to study. As for the prof I never saw him. But the exams he gave were adequate enough. 

TLDR not bad.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of those online professors you never see or hear. There's a ton of material to be covered in this course and all of it was done through assigning interactive questions and material from the online textbook. He also had posted review videos and had the TA hold review PowerPoint readings. The exams covered a ton of material.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Online class so keep this in mind. I only read the assigned chapters in the textbook and did the reviews before each test, and I ended up satisfied with my grade. Professor Atli also provides recorded lectures and recitation sessions before each test for students who need extra help. Understood what was expected from the get-go, overall great prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Overall the course was average in both the workload and difficulty categories. I only experienced difficulty with exam 1, which seems to be the most content heavy exam of the course. Exam 2 and the Final are both extremely doable with moderate preparation. This class can be an easy A, especially since there is substantial extra credit offered.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was an online class, so I never actually met Atli. But he does seem like a pretty nice guy and is helpful in recitation. The only thing is, the exams can be quite hard. First exam will hit you like a train. Second exam is not as bad, but is still tough. Just remember to read EVERYTHING. Lecture slides, textbook, HW, etc. He's a decent prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this course asynchronous, so I wouldnt say I know the prof too well. I can tell you the class is literally just read the weekly lecture slides, do the homeworks, and take the exams based on the slides and the test review. There are not lecture videos, just online resources that I didnt find too helpful. This class is straight memorization
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things
